This is my rented plot where I grow cassava and some yam for the family and to sell at the market. I will apply a small bag of NPK fertilizer that I managed to get through the subsidy program, and I will also spread goat manure from my compound because it helps the tubers grow big. I am using my own cassava cuttings and yam setts saved from last season since improved varieties are hard to find and too costly, and I do not see the need for chemicals or irrigation with the rains we get here in South South. My children and I will handle the planting and weeding, but I will hire two young men for about five days to help with the heavy digging at harvest time.
